column1: You May Experience Reduced Return and Delays on Your Notes Resulting from Changes in the Sponsor’s Servicing System
column3: The Sponsor intends to implement a new servicing system. In anticipation of the implementation of the new system, the Sponsor intends to modify certain system processes targeted to occur during December 2025. Although not anticipated, it is possible that the implementation of the new servicing system could result in certain portions of the servicing system not operating as expected, resulting in a loss of functionality or data delays, which could adversely affect the servicing of the Receivables. One of the process modifications targeted to occur during December 2025 (in anticipation of the later implementation of a new servicing system) will result in a change in the reporting of the Delinquency Threshold Amount, the portion of a scheduled payment that an obligor must fail to pay to be classified as delinquent, from $40 to 10% of the applicable scheduled payment. Although the Sponsor does not currently anticipate that the process modification related to the Delinquency Threshold Amount will have a material adverse effect on the number of contracts determined to be delinquent or defaulted compared to the number that would have been so determined without the change, no assurance can be given that this change will not have a material adverse effect.
